component.name: Patch
component.summary: Calendar, kanban board and todos, synced over Tailscale

description.p: Patch keeps your tasks, your board and your calendar in one native app with a matte black, glassy look. It stays on: a desktop widget shows what is left today, reminders arrive even with the window closed, and a tray icon brings it back.

ul.li: Day, week and month calendar, a kanban board and a list view
Quick add in plain language, like “Lunch with Sam tomorrow 1pm”
A desktop widget that can float above other apps and collapses into a bubble
Sync between your Linux and Android devices over Tailscale; this computer can host the sync hub itself
Matte Black, Liquid Glass and Light looks
